title: Cleverness cannot walk beside you
summary: No clever scheme lasts; only walking in Hukam does. Do not confuse control with care.
takeaway: Do not confuse control with care.
lifeApplication: Before tightening around the outcome again, stop, name what is already here, and release one demand you cannot faithfully carry.

source.shortMeaning: No clever scheme lasts; only walking in Hukam does.
source.lifeApplication: When control gets sharp, return to the next obedient step instead of another trick.
